Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. The Kiwi players are out in the middle.
...SECOND INNINGS...

There is nothing much to write about Sri Lanka as they were made to toil hard with the ball and in the field. They were absolutely tired as we saw some sloppy fielding later on and couple of catches dropped which proved to be a big mistake. Sri Lanka now have to bat a small phase and they will hope to get past without losing any wickets. Stay tuned...

Henry Nicholls was dropped twice, one when he was new to the crease and one in his 90s. He came with a luck and made the most of the opportunity. New Zealand dominated throughout with Devon Conway scoring a fifty but then came the humongous stand between Kane Williamson and Henry Nicholls of around 360.

Tim Southee was waiting for Henry Nicholls to reach his milestone as he declares the innings. The Wellington crowd has witnessed a special day as two local boys have scored double-centuries. Kane Williamson first and then Henry Nicholls followed him. New Zealand have ended with a mammoth score though.

The closest Sri Lanka came to scalp something was when Henry Nicholls was in his 90s but Dhananjaya de Silva dropped off in his own bowling. Sri Lanka look tired but they can't drain more as they have a lot of work to do. This is turning out to be a nightmare already for their bowlers who are not getting much help from the pitch as well. Will New Zealand go past 600 or Sri Lanka pull off something magical?

This is just supreme batting from Henry Nicholls and Williamson who are now just enjoying their time in the middle. Henry Nicholls just changed the style of play once he got past his century and if he continues the same way, New Zealand will definitely go around 600 with ease along with Kane Williamson eyeing a double-century. No doubt, this session belongs to the Kiwis.

Welcome back to the action of Day 2. After a bit of rain delay we got some action and it was the home team who enjoyed the most. Devon Conway scored a fine fifty before getting out but with Kane Williamson and Henry Nicholls still out there, the Kiwis are in a good position. Sri Lanka will hope to bowl with some energy and take wickets regularly. Stay tuned...
...Day 2, Session 1...

Both the Kiwi openers lost their wicket but New Zealand ended the day with Kane Williamson and Henry Nicholls in control of the innings. Sri Lanka had their moments but more often than not they were too wayward. Mostly outside the off line which didn't trouble the batters much. Sri Lanka will hope for a better start on Day 2. Join us back at 3 am IST (9.30 pm GMT, the previous day) Till then, cheers!

The light doesn't get better and that will be STUMPS! Summary of Day 1- The start was pushed as we lost more than a session due to rain. Luckily, we got to see some action as Sri Lanka opted to bowl first on this green layered pitch which turned out to be flat and decent to bat on. Tom Latham and Devon Conway gave a perfect start but the former lost his wicket while the latter went on to make his fifty.

...Day 1, Session 3...

Sri Lanka saw the green pitch and opted to bowl first. However, it is not what you think as this pitch is not aiding the bowlers much, not much off the deck. Sri Lanka have been on and off in this session but some disciplined bowling saw them get the only wicket. They have to bowl tight to get more off this pitch. Stay tuned.

A fine session to start the game and New Zealand will be happy of the two sides. Scoring more than 100 with just one wicket down, they would have taken this as a start. Tom Latham and Devon Conway started well as they hit the loose balls away while respecting the good ones. Tom Latham though gave his wicket away but Devon Conway is making the most of this flat pitch as he has scored a fine fifty and is hungry for more.

We witnessed an absolute humdinger of a game in the first Test. It was New Zealand, thanks to Williamson's brilliance, who came out on top. They now have taken an unassailable lead in the series but they would love to win it 2-0. For Lanka, it is a must-win. Can they put up another fighting performance and this time get over the line? We will find out.
